name: evolvo_find_appointments
description: Look up the caller's appointments in the next 31 days by phone number only; never ask for a name. Precondition: you read the number back digit by digit and the caller answered yes in a later turn - send phone_confirmed true. confirm_phone_first: read the number in read_back back, ask if it is correct, end your turn, then call again with phone_confirmed true. found true returns count, persons[] and appointments[], each with ref (pass it to evolvo_manage_appointment), person, date YYYY-MM-DD, time HH:MM, doctor, location, type, state, kind (appointment or request_pending_staff_confirmation), manageable. state scheduled and confirmed are normal; needs_reschedule means a move was asked for but no new time booked - it still holds its slot, so if they want a new time go straight to evolvo_check_availability and evolvo_book_appointment on this phone number and do not mark it again. Cancelled ones are not returned. You may say these out loud: name one appointment back (person, weekday, date, time) and get an explicit yes before anything is changed. found false: ask whether it was booked with a different number; do not ask for a name.

phone.description: The number the appointment was made with, digits only as dictated, no spaces, no leading zero or country code added or removed.

phone_confirmed.description: true only if you read this exact number back digit by digit and the caller answered yes in a later turn; otherwise false. Never guess.
